messages:
Clara J.: Quick sync: assembling a compact changelog for the docs publish tomorrow. Items: routing policy clarification, embeddings streaming deprecation, and a tiny SDK rename. PRs: #5588 (changelog draft), #5592 (snippet fixes), #5599 (redirects/link fixes). Need short bullets + link sanity sweep.
Noah B.: I'll take the snippets. Plan: replace `client.generate()` -> `client.responses.create()` in py/js/go where present, and add a one-line migration hint above each sample.
Yvonne L.: I'll tidy the text for the changelog bullets. Keep each bullet single-sentence and add one "known issue" line about cache warm-up latency.
ci-bot: CI reminder: docs queue cutoff 06:30 PT. Any changelog PRs must be merged by 05:45 PT to make the publish.
Clara J.: Thanks. Noah, can you also scan for any examples that still reference streaming embeddings and change them to a polling hint? Short code hint is fine: JS: `const job = await client.embeddings.create({input: batch}); // poll job.status`
Noah B.: Yep, will do. Pushing a tiny commit to #5592 now.
Yvonne L.: Proposed changelog bullets (draft): "Adaptive routing defaults updated to prefer warmed pools; canary traffic may route to fallbacks during warm-up." and "Embedding streaming deprecated; use batch embeddings + polling (see migration guide)." Keep it terse.
Clara J.: Good. docs-bot: can you run a link-check after redirects MR merges?
docs-bot: Link-check scheduled post-merge. Please ensure redirects MR (#5599) addresses old /beta-console absolute links.
Noah B.: #5592 updated: py/js/go snippets renamed, added migration one-liners. CI green.
ci-bot: #5592 checks passed.
Noah B.: Merged #5592.
Yvonne L.: I pushed microedits to #5588 (language and the known-issue line).
ci-bot: #5599 redirect MR shows one anchor mismatch on /guides/auth.
Noah B.: Fixed the anchor in #5599 and reopened.
ci-bot: #5599 now passes link checks.
Clara J.: Final checklist: merge #5588, #5592, #5599 and run link-check. If anything breaks after publish, post "docs-rollback" and tag @Clara J.
Yvonne L.: #5588 merged. Changelog queued for publish.
docs-bot: Changelog queued. Post-publish link-check will run. If regressions, use "docs-rollback".
Clara J.: Thanks team! Short retro: next time let's add a tiny snippet-parity checklist to the PR template. :memo:
